title: Tail-weighted sum identity
statement: For every $t\in\mathbb R$ and $n\in\mathbb N$, the uniform expectation of the normalized Rademacher sum multiplied by the indicator that it exceeds $t$ is the sum of the uniform expectation of its excess above $t$ (with negative values replaced by zero) and $t$ times the uniform expectation of that indicator.
